subject: Emit window probe & TTFT commitment for EdgeFin pilot
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@edgefin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Emit window probe & TTFT commitment for EdgeFin pilot

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we spin up a test pool.

Recap (what we took away)
- Primary goal: validate streaming behavior and Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) under realistic EdgeFin traffic patterns ahead of pilot.
- Preferred streaming transport: SSE for simplicity, WebSocket as fallback for bi-directional needs.
- Key constraints: ~512-token typical responses, some longer (1k tokens) for certain workflows.

Proposed SLO targets to validate in the probe (we can relax during procurement conversations):
- TTFT targets (measured from request arrival at our edge to first byte emitted): P50 <= 60 ms, P95 <= 220 ms for responses <= 512 tokens.
- Throughput: sustained 150 req/s per pilot shard during peak window; burst capacity to 350 rps for short spikes.
- Concurrency: support 200 concurrent streaming sessions per shard (pilot target 2 shards).
- Chunk cadence for streaming: initial chunk within TTFT window above; subsequent chunks emitted at ~<=70 ms cadence where model output available; chunk sizes target 64–128 tokens (configurable).

Telemetry & measurement plan
- We'll tag probe traffic with trace=EDGEFIN-ttft-001 and include token-level timing (first-byte, chunk-emit timestamps) in our analysis.
- We'll produce a CSV with per-request timings (attached: edgefin-ttft-probe-template.csv) and a short runbook for the 48-hour probe.

Immediate asks for EdgeFin
1) Confirm that SSE is acceptable for the initial probe (we will keep WS fallback ready).
2) Share an infra contact to provision a secure test endpoint or provide IP allowlist (Tom Nguyen OK to loop in?).
3) Confirm target pilot kickoff window (we propose 2027-11-16 / 2027-11-17 for the 48-hour probe).

Proposed schedule
- 11/15: kickoff call — confirm runbook and traffic profile (30–45 min).
- 11/16–11/17: 48-hour probe (synthetic + small sandboxes of real traffic).
- 11/20: analysis and follow-up with sample CSV + recommendations + SLA draft.

I'll attach the runbook and probe template (see attachments) and share the drive link for live telemetry. Ben will own the run execution on our side; Monica will own the outcome/acceptance criteria and analysis.

Thanks — Markus

Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: edgefin-ttft-probe-template.csv (CSV with columns: request_id, start_ts, first_byte_ts, chunk_ts_list, total_tokens), edgefin-ttft-pilot-runbook.md

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@edgefin.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@edgefin.com>, procurement@edgefin.com
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Emit window probe & TTFT commitment for EdgeFin pilot

Hey Markus — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 

- SSE is fine for now; our infra lead Tom (cc'd) will confirm any firewall/ALB changes.
- On TTFT thresholds: engineering asked if we can budget P95 up to 250 ms given some complex prompt priming they'll be doing during the pilot. Is 250 ms still workable for the probe so we can iterate? If we see good P50 already, happy to tighten later.
- Procurement: looping procurement for the SLA draft and to get a PO in motion; procurement@edgefin.com is on cc.

We can do the kickoff call on 11/15 at 10am PT. If that works, Tom and I will send the traffic profile by EOD tomorrow (11/10). Also — if you have a short checklist of what we need to allow (IP ranges, headers, auth), share that and we'll start the security work.

Thanks — Sarah

Sarah Jones
Head of Product — EdgeFin
sarah.jones@edgefin.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@edgefin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Emit window probe & TTFT commitment for EdgeFin pilot

Thanks Sarah — 250 ms P95 is fine for the probe window; we'll mark that as the conservative acceptance threshold. Operational items and next steps: 

1) Security checklist (short) — what you need to allow for the probe:
   - Allowlist: 3 Redwoods egress IPs (will send list in separate secure message).
   - Headers: tracer-id, x-edgefin-session-id, authorization (Bearer).
   - Certificate pinning not required for the probe; we will use mutual TLS for Private pilots if/when we move to Dedicated.

2) Pilot run details
   - Kickoff meeting: 2027-11-15 10:00 PT (agenda: confirm traffic profile, success criteria, timing).
   - Probe window: 2027-11-16 00:00 PT -> 2027-11-17 23:59 PT (48 hours).
   - Metrics we will deliver: per-request TTFT, chunk cadence histogram, per-minute throughput, concurrency heatmap, token usage and per-token cost estimate.

3) Action owners
   - Redwood run execution: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com) — provisioning and live load generation.
   - Redwood analysis & acceptance: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com).
   - EdgeFin infra lead: Tom Nguyen (tom.nguyen@edgefin.com) — firewall/allowlist test.

4) Attachments & links
   - Attached: edgefin-ttft-pilot-runbook.md (run steps), edgefin-ttft-probe-template.csv (output format).
   - Drive (live telemetry): https://redwood.company/drive/edgefin-ttft-probe
   - Draft SLA for procurement: sla-draft-edgefin.pdf (we'll iterate after probe).

If that all looks good I'll send a calendar invite for the kickoff and a short pre-kickoff checklist to help your infra team test connectivity before 11/15.

Markus

--
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: EdgeFin probe capacity check

Markus / Monica — quick internal note on the run:
- Can we reserve capacity for 2 pilot shards (targeting 200 concurrent streams each) during 11/16–11/17? I'll also enable our streaming prefix cache to reduce repeated priming cost during synthetic runs.
- For the model runtime: plan to run the quantized variant (INT8) for the pilot to get cost/latency realism; if EdgeFin wants higher fidelity we can flip to FP16 for a subset.
- I'll prep the run scripts and a short smoke test (SSE handshake + first-chunk timing) for 11/14 so Tom can verify connectivity.

I'll share the reserved pool IDs once provisioned.

Ben

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
